items.title: George "Jug" Jernberg Interview, 1963-08-23
items.q: A lot of the others did too, Sophie Tucker, all of them.

ctx.x: Because theater treasures had a close contact with them.

That's right. The legit theaters. They were all there, and Joe Frisco went nuts about our band. He didn't even dance. All he did all night long from the time we started to play, he just sat on a chair right in front of the bandstand and went out of his noodle about this band. A lot of the others did too, Sophie Tucker, all of them. They thought they were really paying attention to that band.
Joe Frisco, it was always a real stutter with him, wasn't it?
